title_options: Changed Your Embedding Model? Check for Silent Retrieval Errors
Same Vector Width, Wrong Neighbours: Why an Embedding Swap Fails Silently
How to Catch a Silent Embedding-Swap Failure in Agent Memory
presentation.title_rationale: The reader problem is a maintenance swap that keeps the schema valid while rankings silently change. The selected title names the trigger (changed embedding model) and the one supported benefit (checking for silent retrieval errors) in 63 characters, without claiming a fix, a percentage or a measured production effect; the 40-document recall harness is described in the description and introduction rather than crammed into the headline.
presentation.visual_purpose: The cover is a conceptual three-step checklist — encoder identity, vector dimensions, retrieval checks — matching the article's point that a dimension check tests only the third property while the encoder check is what catches a same-width swap. It carries no measurements and labels itself 'conceptual checklist, not measurement data', so it explains scope rather than asserting results.
